test_cumcount: test the groupby cumcount method that returns a 0-based cumulative count within each group
test_cumcount_empty: test the groupby cumcount method with an empty dataframe and empty series
test_cumcount_dupe_index: test the groupby cumcount method with a duplicate index
test_cumcount_mi: test the groupby cumcount method with a multiindex dataframe
test_ngroup: test the groupby ngroup method that assigns unique group numbers to each row
test_ngroup_descending: test the groupby ngroup method with ascending and descending order parameters
test_ngroup_cumcount_pair: test the groupby ngroup and cumcount methods produce consistent results
test_ngroup_respects_groupby_order: test the groupby ngroup and cumcount methods respect the sort parameter order
test_count_with_datetimelike: test the groupby count method with datetime-like columns including timestamps timedeltas and periods
test_count_with_only_nans_in_first_group: test the groupby count method when the first group contains only NaN values
test_count_groupby_column_with_nan_in_gr: test the groupby count method when the groupby column itself contains NaN values
test_count: test the groupby count method on a large dataframe with multiple column types and NaN values
test_count_non_nulls: test the groupby count method counts only non-null values per group
test_count_object: test the groupby count method on object dtype columns
test_count_object_nan: test the groupby count method on object columns with NaN values
test_count_cross_type: test the groupby count method with cross-type columns including object and float32 dtypes
test_lower_int_prec_count: test the groupby count method with low precision integer dtypes
test_count_arrow_string_array: test the groupby count method with arrow-backed string arrays
